omni.quote_basis: Indicative quote from the stats API snapshot: (ask - bid) / ((ask + bid) / 2) at size_100k and size_1m. Null when the size is not quoted, a side is zero, or the listing carries no quotes (swap closed).
omni.fee_quote: There are no trading fees on Omni.

base_taker_sources: https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/trading/fees (Perps fee tiers, tier 0 base rate: taker 0.045%)
POST https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info {"type":"userFees"}: feeSchedule.cross = 0.00045, userCrossRate = 0.00045 for an address with no volume, stake or referral
hyperliquid.builder_dex_formula: taker = base * (scale + 1 if scale < 1 else scale * 2) * (0.1 if growthMode else 1), from 'Fee formula for developers' on the fees page; scale and growthMode are the market's deployerFeeScale and growthMode in {"type":"meta","dex":"xyz"}
hyperliquid.fee_basis: Base tier, taker, per side, before any volume-tier, staking or referral discount and excluding any front-end builder fee. Volume tiers cut the base rate to as little as 2.4 bps and staking by up to a further 40%, so the base tier is the most a taker pays.
hyperliquid.verified_note: Per-side base-tier rates that have been checked against the docs and against fills: 4.5 on validator-operated perpetuals; on trade[XYZ] (deployerFeeScale 1.0) 9.0 standard and 0.9 in growth mode. A capture that computes any other rate (a changed deployerFeeScale) is published without a fee until this file is re-verified.

lighter.book: wss://mainnet.zklighter.elliot.ai/stream channel order_book/<market_id>: full snapshot, exact price levels, server timestamp in ms. Fallback when the socket fails: GET /api/v1/orderBookOrders?market_id=<id>&limit=250 (best 250 orders a side, book time from the HTTP Date header, good to about two seconds).
lighter.fee_basis: Standard account (the default account type), regular orders, per side. Lighter has no volume tiers.
fee_sources: https://docs.lighter.xyz/trading/trading-fees (Standard Account (Default): 0 maker / 0 taker on regular perpetual and spot orders; 1 bp on TWAP/advanced orders and RFQ)
GET https://mainnet.zklighter.elliot.ai/api/v1/feeTiers: tier standard taker_fee_ticks 0; plus 50; premium 280
GET https://mainnet.zklighter.elliot.ai/api/v1/orderBooks: taker_fee 0.0000 on each of the nine mapped markets
lighter.not_applied: Opt-in account types pay fees and are not what this figure shows: Plus 0.5 bps maker and taker; Premium/Advanced 2.8 bps taker and 0.4 bps maker at no LIT staked, falling to 1.96 bps taker at 500,000 LIT staked, in exchange for 140 ms taker latency instead of 300 ms. A Standard account pays 1 bp on TWAP/advanced orders and RFQ.
lighter.live_guard: Each capture reads /orderBooks: a mapped id whose symbol differs from this file, or whose market is not an active perp, is recorded as a failure and not priced; a non-zero taker_fee there records the fee as unverified (null).
dropped: SPY (id 128) and QQQ (id 129): perpetuals on the ETF shares, not on the index. Omni lists the same ETFs as its own perpetuals (US500-PERP, QQQ-PERP), separate from the index swaps compared here.
PAXG (id 48): tokenised gold, a crypto asset, not spot gold.
